definitions.explanation: The history of the world, and the high-school subject of that name, which in Japan covers history outside Japan. It pairs with {日本史|にほんし}.

examples.japanese: {世界史|せかいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧。
⟦{受験|じゅけん}→受験：04272_juken⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世界史|せかいし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I chose world history for the entrance exams.

examples.japanese: ⟦{産業革命|さんぎょうかくめい}→産業革命：18638_sangyoukakumei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世界史|せかいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}えた→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦{出来事|できごと}→出来事：03446_dekigoto⟧だ。
examples.english: The Industrial Revolution was an event that greatly changed the course of world history.

notes:
⟦{世界|せかい}→世界：01447_sekai⟧ (world) + 〜⟦{史|し}→〜史：28471_shi⟧ (history of).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世界史|せかいし}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: to go down in world history
- {世界史|せかいし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧: a world history textbook
- {世界史|せかいし}⟦{選択|せんたく}→選択：03306_sentaku⟧: taking world history as one's elective

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japanese high schools, history is split into ⟦{日本史|にほんし}→日本史：31408_nihonshi⟧ and {世界史|せかいし}, and university entrance exams usually ask students to choose one.
